A queen put all her gold on a scale... and lost to one leaf. Dwarka. Satyabhama, Krishna's queen, is proud of two things. Her husband. And her jewellery.
Then the sage Narada drops by with an idea. Give Krishna to me as a gift. Want him back? Pay his weight in gold. Easy, she thinks.
Krishna sits on one side of the scale. In go the necklaces. The bangles. The crowns. The whole treasury. And the scale... doesn't move.
Wait. So why is his food always offered with one tulsi leaf? Rukmini walks in. No gold. Just one tulsi leaf, and his name on her lips.
She places it on the pile... and the scale tips. Krishna can't be bought. But he can be loved.
That's why, even today, his food is offered with a tulsi leaf. And at Guruvayur, people still sit on a scale and give their weight in bananas.
Gold lost. A leaf won. Comment Tulsi if you knew this one.
